about.title:
HELLO THERE
I'M SHANTANU
about.subtitle: Generalist Game Programmer
paragraphs: I have been playing video games for as long as I can remember. Eventually, just playing them wasn't enough so I wanted to know how they were made. That curiosity turned into a career, and I have been hooked on game development ever since.

I have over three years of experience working with Unity and C#, with the last two years spent professionally developing and shipping titles. As a generalist, I love getting my hands in every part of the engine. My work ranges from rapid R&D prototyping and programming core gameplay, to hooking up animations and audio, all the way to building full multiplayer architectures with custom matchmaking, leaderboards, and web APIs.

Whether I am participating in a weekend game jam to test out a weird new idea, learning a new tool, or collaborating with artists to polish a mechanic, I just genuinely love making games. I am always eager to solve interesting technical problems and help teams bring fun experiences to life.

experience.title: Game Programmer | Parody Studios
bullets: Independently completed and released two multiplayer titles; built robust systems around core mechanics including game modes, server-side validation, and admin panels.
Implemented secure backend pipelines using Firebase and Playfab; engineered custom matchmaking logic via User IDs and synced complete player states.
Spearheaded R&D on Animation Rigging for procedural animations, integrating them into production builds.
Collaborated with art teams to implement ragdoll physics, custom shaders, and responsive UI animations.

education: B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering | IIIT Pune

projects.title: Real-Time Multiplayer Hand Cricket
projects.description: Performance-optimized up to 5v5 team-based multiplayer game utilizing Unity Netcode, Relay, and Lobby services with custom RPCs and cross-platform Android/WebGL simulation.

rows.text: Optimized game footprint to fit into a 34MB APK with strict asset management.
Utilized Unity Netcode for GameObjects (NGO) alongside Unity Relay to bypass strict NAT punch-through issues on mobile networks.
Integrated Unity Lobby to handle 5v5 matchmaking and synced states using custom RPCs and compressed integers.
Engineered deterministic simulation loops to ensure WebGL and Android clients stayed perfectly synchronized despite frame-rate discrepancies.

projects.title: State-Based 2D Boss Fight
projects.description: Modular boss AI designed using Finite State Machines to manage complex behavior transitions, attack patterns, and animation events across multiple combat phases.

rows.text: Engineered a modular Finite State Machine (FSM) architecture to manage complex boss behavior transitions without massive update loops.
Programmed distance checks and health thresholds to drive dynamic state transitions.
Tied hitbox activations directly to Animation Events, ensuring damage frames perfectly sync with the visual swing of the weapon.

projects.title: Infinite Runner with Custom Shader
projects.description: Custom vertex shader simulating world curvature with procedural environment generation and multi-character selection featuring seamless restart logic.

rows.text: Wrote a custom HLSL vertex shader that offsets the Y-axis of vertices based on Z-distance, creating world curvature while maintaining flat physics colliders.
Engineered a procedural generation system using an object pool of track segments to recycle geometry and maintain a strict 60 FPS on lower-end mobile devices.

projects.title: Deterministic Rollback Netcode Prototype
projects.description: Lockstep rollback networking prototype built from scratch with fixed-point arithmetic, circular state history buffers, and bit-packed input delta compression.

rows.text: Wrote a custom fixed-point math library to ensure 100% deterministic physics simulations across different CPU architectures.
Engineered a system to bit-pack inputs into lightweight integers for UDP transmission.
Developed circular state history buffers to rewind the simulation, apply delayed inputs, and fast-forward back to the current frame in a single tick.

projects.title: Runtime Memory Profiler & Object Pooler
projects.description: Lightweight in-engine memory allocation auditor and generic multi-tier pool manager eliminating GC spikes across scene streaming cycles.

rows.text: Developed a lightweight in-engine memory allocation auditor.
Engineered a generic multi-tier pool manager eliminating GC spikes across scene streaming cycles.
